picks.thesis: Dollar Tree's third quarter (release filed with the SEC 2026-11-24) beat on sales ($5.07B, +6.9%), comparable sales (+4.6%, traffic +3.8%) and adjusted EPS ($1.16 against about $0.91 expected), and it raised its fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $8.05-$8.25 from $7.70-$8.05 (consensus about $7.94). The stock gapped up 11% to about $154.66 and held above its open and VWAP at 10:21 ET: a 6%+ gap on a guidance raise (rule 2). Smallest size: the Q4 EPS guide's midpoint is just under consensus and about $0.65 of the outlook is tariff refunds. Waits for room under the 75% cap.
picks.wrong_if: closes below $147.00 (more than half of today's gap given back), or the company cuts or withdraws the fiscal 2026 outlook it raised today
